# Synthetic Literature Article 1 — Rapid-Onset HIT Exception

[EVIDENCE:literature_a1_hit_rapid_onset] A patient with circulating platelet factor 4–heparin antibodies from a recent prior heparin exposure can develop rapid-onset immune heparin-induced thrombocytopenia, with the platelet fall beginning within 24 hours after re-exposure.

[EVIDENCE:literature_a1_hit_antibody_persistence] The earlier onset is explained by preexisting circulating antibodies; when no recent prior exposure is present, the usual immune response develops over several days.
